Recommended subject_id families: canonical small set doc:<document_id>, artifact:<artifact_id>; avoid thread/run/wizard/safe_point as subject_id when better as object_kind/object_id

Recommended early object_kind: conversational thread, message, wizard, usage_event; execution run, node, attempt, scheduler_pass, blocked_episode, safe_point, remediation; orchestration feature_seam, work_package, lane, worktree, concern, promotion, graph_patch, graph_generation
Generally NOT object_kind: raw UI container state (panel/tab/split/layout), transport artifacts resume_url/generated://, provider/account disclosure as target kinds
object_id uses canonical domain identities from docs (thread_id, message_id, wizard_id, run_id, attempt_id, etc.); avoid route-local surrogates; sub-selection via inspector_target or specialized verb

## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Sub-selection and `inspector_target` should stay secondary
Surfaces need more than open object X (node graph detail, document history, wizard step, message focus, file line/range) but sub-selection kinds differ and must not all become first-class identity
Split: canonical target identity lands object/surface; secondary focus/sub-selection reveals highlight; inspector_target for reusable detail/subsection focus not universal dumping ground
route_target owns main identity/scope only; sub-selection via OpenFile line/range, inspector_target for reusable detail focus, or object-family anchors only when truly domain-local
Good inspector_target fits: detail section/subsection, evidence vs history vs review tabs, node detail subsection, stable reusable document pane modes
Poor inspector_target fits: wizard_step as primary identity, message_id when target is the message, line/range, raw provider fields, arbitrary per-feature blobs

Normalization: thread hit object_kind message + object_id with thread_id context; wizard resume object_kind wizard + object_id; node graph object_kind node or attempt + inspector_target; file OpenFile { path, line, range }
Wizard step/clarification focus is domain-local anchor or serialized deep-link detail not base identity; node graph uses inspector_target evidence/history/reviews; file uses OpenFile
Impacted docs (sub-selection): primary Contracts_V0, FinalGUISpec, Orchestrator_Page, FileManager; cross assistant-chat-design, storage-plan, UI_Command_Catalog
Docs blur which object vs which part of UI; without sub-selection rule payloads bloat or surfaces invent custom anchors; wizard_step matters operationally but must not wizard-shape base target
Define inspector_target narrowly as reusable detail focus; line/range under OpenFile; object-family anchors only with justification
Do-not-forget: canonical identity vs UI focus are separate layers; prevents route-target contract becoming per-surface deep-link spaghetti

Navigation lacks explicit migration discipline like events/runtime recovery; risk freezing old payloads or overclaiming flag day; wrappers real but docs lack canonical vs deprecated transport rule

Reuse event-alias and recovery-command migration template; wrappers stay for UX but underlying target canonical; explicit migration notes for raw IDs to subject_id/object_kind; wiring docs distinguish canonical vs wrapper vs deprecated

Internal canonical route_target; external narrowed serializable decodes into route_target; resume_url one transport instance

Good serialized: object_kind/object_id or subject_id; scope project_id/thread_id/focused_run_id; narrow anchors wizard step message usage record. Bad: panel dock, splits, scroll offsets except contract-dependent, broad inspector expansion, provider disclosure as target

resume_url concrete while route-target implicit; risk serializing entire model or one-off URL shapes; wizard URL should not stand alone as only precise deep-link contract
Define resume_url as serialized route-target in contract; serialized narrower than internal; family-specific anchor material only when needed; decode all forms to same internal path
Do-not-forget: serialization preserves work intent not every UI detail; restraint; wizard deep-link precedent in normalized transport family
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Shell/workspace state should remain adjacent to routing, not inside it

Shell persists dock/floating, side panel visibility, activity bar order, workspace-tab identity, project_state, per-surface state, browser/document/chat/editor shell — important but not canonical route identity

Routing chooses target and destination surface/context; shell state realizes layout; route may name visible surface/tab/panel and project context but not panel widths/coords/icon order/full project_state snapshots

Boundary: routing answers what object, broad destination, project/run/thread context; shell persistence handles docking, workspace tab host, per-project layout; destination intent not raw shell-state restoration payload
Impacted docs (shell boundary): primary FinalGUISpec, storage-plan, Crosswalk, Contracts_V0; cross UI_Command_Catalog, feature-list, FileManager, Orchestrator_Page

Payloads blur destination intent with shell-state realization; cmd.panel.switch useful but must not become universal navigation primitive; project_state records adjacent restore not canonical route payload

Keep shell persistence in shell/storage docs; route names major surfaces/tabs/panels when needed; workspace-tab docking layout restore are shell layered under canonical routing; cmd.panel.switch consumes routing context not replaces it
Do-not-forget: routing asks where user lands not how every panel laid out; shell and route cooperate without collapsing contracts
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Destination-surface vocabulary should stay controlled and coarse

Coarse destination classes: primary_view (Dashboard Projects Wizard Interview Settings Usage FileEditor Orchestrator); side_panel (chat files source_control github_actions docker_manager artifacts run_debug); bottom_panel (terminal problems output ports browser debug); embedded_surface (document_pane agent_activity); page_tab (Orchestrator Progress Seams Node Graph Evidence History Ledger)
Stay out of destination vocab: dock/floating realization, side-panel width, exact subview selected repo/compare, widget slots, remembered collapse prefs
Commands mix coarse destination with detailed shell/subview state; side-panel vs page-tab stable but not connected cleanly to routing; too-fine destination vocab re-imports shell implementation
Controlled coarse destination enum in route contract; object identity separate from destination; shell state refines after landing; page-tab and panel-subview as destination-layer not core identity
Let object identity and scope pick thing to show; destination picks major surface class; shell state handles rest; page-tab and panel-subview resolution as destination-layer not core identity
Do-not-forget: route needs destination intent only at coarse level; cross-surface pivots without mirroring whole shell; Orchestrator tab and side-panel routing fit with explicit coarse vocabulary
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Subviews and panel-local selectors belong to view state, not target identity

Surfaces persist subview/selection: Source Control active_subview repo/worktree/compare/filters; GitHub Actions subview branch/workflows/run; Docker Manager subview runtime/registry/publish; document pane doc/view/history/approval — destination may land in surface; panel-local refines; not object_kind/subject_id/base route identity
Impacted docs (subviews): primary storage-plan, UI_Command_Catalog, FinalGUISpec, Contracts_V0; cross Crosswalk, Orchestrator_Page
Commands package destination and panel-local state as one; docs unclear when route overrides remembered subview vs reuses; risk route absorbing filter/subview noise

Keep active_subview filters compare pinned in destination/view-state contracts; routes optionally name destination-local subview as refinement not base identity; reuse persisted state when route omits override
Do-not-forget: land in Source Control without full serialized source_control.project_state; destination refinement one layer below canonical target identity
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Override rule: route-target should override only what is necessary

Override policy: MUST override target identity, destination surface when action names different surface, scope for meaningful target; MAY reuse docking/subview/filters when they do not hide target; MUST NOT reuse when wrong object, wrong tab/subview, stale run/thread/project

Examples: show_in_usage opens correct project/thread/run scope; open_in_source_control lands with worktree/repo context may reuse subview if target clear; Resume Wizard overrides wizard surface/step; focus_thread_usage focuses thread usage may reuse panel dock

Shared route-activation override rule in contract/GUI docs; conditional reuse when not obscuring target; same rule for search artifacts Usage attention cards pivots
Do-not-forget: predictability; precise enough to arrive, restrained enough not to trash unrelated shell state; override only what is necessary ties routing and shell-state
